changes.text: Plays weren't sent on Linux when osu! wasn't in osu-winello's default folder.
Always on top, from the pin in the title bar or in the settings.
This changelog, shown after an update.
Plays in multiplayer rooms weren't sent.
Plays on maps without a leaderboard linked to an empty one.
Right-click menu only shows on text boxes and links.
Text and images can't be selected or dragged.
Title bar icon follows the theme color.
Avatar and profile color could be out of date.
Retrying from the results screen was taken for watching a replay, so the play wasn't sent.
Data folder renamed from mania-bridge to Hashi. The old one is moved over on start.
Sends finished osu!mania plays to Mania Tracker through tosu.
Map leaderboards, with your rank on each play.
Live status on your profile while osu! is open.
Theme color, dans and lazer mod badges.
Downloads and starts tosu if you don't have it.
